73 sal ki vidya kaur bizi sarkon, patli galiyon aur bhir bhare bazaron men jab apni gari lekar nikalti hain, to log dekhte rah jate hain. jammu-kashmir ki ye ritayard skul tichar soshal midiya senseshan ban gaee hain. unki draiving ke vidiyo soshal midiya par bhi bahut sheyar kie jate hain. vidya kaur se janie draiving ke lie unka paishan kaise shuru huaa?
